sourceReview.reason: The complete TechFlow report dated 2026-11-12 (https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/144418) attributes Avalanche C-Chain's approximately 5% tokenized-stock share as of November 8, $3.73bn total capitalization and 287 assets above $1m to The Block citing RWA.xyz. WorldPing (https://worldping.lovable.app/news/crypto/avalanche-owns-five-percent-of-tokenized-stocks-nyoonh) explicitly credits The Block and is not independent reporting. No directly inspected dated RWA.xyz dataset or two independent full-text investigations establish the precise share and denominator. Remain held; retry at least six hours after this review.
